outputs.explanation: Panel A shows a representative spatial transcriptomic cluster map from a single lung section with no quantification, averaging, or statistical comparison, so replicate reporting is not applicable.
Panel B is a representative H&E image with manual region annotation from the same single section; no quantitative or statistical data requiring replicate reporting is shown.

Panel C shows representative spatial expression maps overlaid on the H&E image from the same single section; it is descriptive/representative rather than a quantitative summary requiring replicate information.

replicate_statements: Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) from T11b-high versus low squamous tumors (S1&S2 versus S3) with normalized enrichment scores (NES), false discovery rate (FDR) and P values for the indicated gene signatures.
statistical significance was determined by bootstrapping with 1000 permutations
outputs.explanation: This panel reports statistical significance (NES, FDR, P values) comparing T11b-high vs low regions, which implies replicated observations (e.g., spots/samples), but the caption does not state how many replicates/units were compared or what they represent (e.g., number of spots, sections, or animals).

replicate_statements: Differential gene expression was calculated using Seurat's FindAllMarkers function, and direct comparisons between two classes and corresponding P values were obtained using Seurat's FindMarkers function with the Wilcoxon rank-sum test with Bonferroni P value correction.
outputs.explanation: The bar graph presents log2 fold-change values with associated P values from a statistical comparison (Wilcoxon rank-sum test) between Tmprss11b-high and low tumor regions, but the number and type of underlying replicates/units (e.g., number of spots or samples per group) are not reported.
